binders: Universally quantified real constants K = bulkModulus and rho = density, implicit in Lean.
Universally quantified system : LocalDef001 K rho, with projections p = system.pressure and u = system.velocity, each a function R → R → R.
Within the second conclusion, universally quantified x,t ∈ R, in that order.
For each x,t in the second conclusion, existential real witnesses wt and wx, in that order, for the two slice derivatives of the fixed function w.
In the system constructor's requirements, for each x,t ∈ R there are existential real witnesses pt,px,ut,ux, in that order. These witnesses may depend on the parameters, functions and point.
hypotheses: A system at the fixed real parameters K,rho is supplied.
The displayed system constructor takes rho ≠ 0 and real-valued functions p,u defined for every real x,t.

The constructor also requires that for every real x,t, the derivatives pt = d/dτ p(x,τ)|τ=t, px = d/dξ p(ξ,t)|ξ=x, ut = d/dτ u(x,τ)|τ=t and ux = d/dξ u(ξ,t)|ξ=x exist and satisfy pt + K ux = 0 and ut + rho⁻¹ px = 0. Reading these as exhaustive bundled assumptions has the qualification recorded under ambiguities.
conclusions: For c = sqrt(K/rho), one has c > 0.
For w(x,t) = p(x,t) + (rho c)u(x,t), at every x,t ∈ R there exist real wt,wx such that τ ↦ w(x,τ) has derivative wt at t, ξ ↦ w(ξ,t) has derivative wx at x, and wt + c wx = 0.
The positivity assertion and the universally quantified derivative-and-equation assertion hold conjunctively for the same fixed c and w.
mathematical_definitions: R has its ordinary field operations, order, absolute-value norm and usual topology.
K and rho are constant real parameters, not functions of x or t.
c is the prescribed nonnegative real square root of K/rho, not an arbitrary root or an existential speed.
p and u are respectively the second and third projections of the supplied system; their pressure and velocity roles introduce no additional physical assumptions.
w is exactly the plus combination p + rho c u, evaluated pointwise.
The pointwise transport predicate requires both separate ordinary derivatives to exist and their values to satisfy w_t + c w_x = 0.
The pointwise system predicate requires all four separate first derivatives to exist and satisfy p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + rho⁻¹ p_x = 0.
Each derivative is an unrestricted derivative of a real-variable slice at a real point, rather than a derivative within a subset.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of real constants K,rho and every supplied system of type LocalDef001 K rho, write p and u for its pressure and velocity projections. If K/rho > 0, then c = sqrt(K/rho) is strictly positive and the explicitly defined function w(x,t) = p(x,t) + rho c u(x,t) has both separate first derivatives at every real point (x,t), with w_t(x,t) + c w_x(x,t) = 0. The supplied constructor describes such systems as carrying rho ≠ 0 and functions satisfying p_t + K u_x = 0 and u_t + rho⁻¹ p_x = 0 everywhere, with all four slice derivatives existing; interpreting this description as an exhaustive characterization of the system type is subject to the dossier omission recorded below.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The positive-ratio hypothesis implies K and rho are nonzero and have the same sign. It allows both to be negative; separate positivity of density or bulk modulus is not assumed.
Real division and inversion are totalized at zero, but rho = 0 cannot satisfy K/rho > 0. The supplied constructor additionally requires rho ≠ 0.
For K/rho ≤ 0 the implication gives no conclusion; the positivity hypothesis is false.
The theorem is conditional on a supplied system and does not itself assert that one exists. A universal claim over an empty system type would be vacuous.
All coordinates range over the whole real line, including negative times. There is no restricted spatial region, time interval or boundary.
The definitions require separate first derivatives pointwise. They do not explicitly require continuous derivatives, joint differentiability, second derivatives or a C1 regularity class.
Existential derivative witnesses are local to each point. No globally continuous derivative functions are specified.
Only the combination p + rho c u and the transport equation with the plus sign are asserted. No assertion for p - rho c u is included.
No initial or boundary data, solution existence or uniqueness, characteristic representation, conservation law, or physical interpretation of c is encoded in the conclusion.
ambiguities: D001 supplies only the type Real → Real → Type, without its full inductive declaration or elimination/projection rules for its proof fields. D007 gives a constructor with nonzero-density and global differential-equation arguments, and D002–D003 give the function projections. This supports the bundled-system reading, but the packet does not explicitly establish that D007 is the only constructor or provide the projections recovering its proof arguments from every arbitrary system. The expanded conclusion is unambiguous; the exhaustive characterization of the system's bundled assumptions remains qualified.
